title: Capitalism: A Love Story …
excerpt: Grace and I went to see it last night. It’s very much worth seeing. Mike Todd offers some interesting responses here. I found Michael Moore’s reflections on Jesus and Capitalism especially interesting – resonant with my chapters on Theo-capitalism in EMC.
body:
Grace and I went to see it last night. It’s very much worth seeing.

Mike Todd offers some interesting responses here.

I found Michael Moore’s reflections on Jesus and Capitalism especially interesting – resonant with my chapters on Theo-capitalism in EMC.
